checks.name: Fixed numerical evidence interpreted within its bounds

checks.name: Calibration caveats

checks.name: PCM16 boundary
checks.details: 32768 decoder denominator versus earlier 32767 export multiplier preserved in all locales; quantized decoded values are not original floats.

checks.name: Frame coordinates and matrix semantics

checks.name: Source versus runtime/advisory implementation
checks.details: Pinned source observations and temporary numerical reproduction remain distinct from IX binary execution; advisory metadata is not a ratified schema or implemented ComfyUI bridge.

checks.name: Display control/reference/crop/floor
checks.details: C is the actual decay candidate; 0.5B is constructed. Common unit-peak reference differs from full-matrix-relative maximum; maximum precedes crop and ratio precedes floor. Only appropriate non-floored cells support the gain shift.

checks.name: Historical gate retained
checks.details: Original results, display record and all courses agree: 0.11416614959438576 dB improvement is below 1 dB; candidate failed.

checks.name: Learner task and criterion coverage
checks.details: All 15 criteria individually mapped below to course content and the three task prompts; outcomes remain null and no participant success is inferred.

checks.name: Figure inspected
checks.details: Viewed PNG: columns B/C/0.5B, rows with 20log10(A/1) and 20log10(A/max A) colorbar references, shared -80 to 0 limits, 0-2000 Hz crop and seconds axes; top control darker, lower pattern agrees. No usability or perceptual approval claimed.

checks.name: No false documentation-readback success
checks.details: Primary-readback record preserves failed direct NumPy requests (403) separately from documented web reads and successful byte bindings; no remote requests replayed in this audit.

distinctness_reviews.details: AUD003 concerns event attribution, window placement and Haar transient preservation. AUD006 adds measured coherent-window amplitude calibration, endpoint controls and decoder/reference boundaries.

CS012 concerns native/WASM builds, event-free block partition probes and float/PCM byte contracts. CS013 concerns spectral matrix orientation, stride, physical axes, value units and missing semantic context.

DV007 concerns aligned classifier diagnostic panels for OPTIC-K partitions. DV009 constructs an exact audio gain control to distinguish a shared numeric scale from a shared reference, with crop/floor order and fixed versus relative matrices.

resolved_review_notes.issue: Conventional coherent-gain terminology could obscure that the near-doubling is in window sum.
resolved_review_notes.resolution: Final English explicitly says window-sum gain; French and Spanish explicitly refer to the sum of coefficients. Final wording checked and bound.
